description: Election Commission - I. M. Rafeek was Selected as the Member of the Addalachchenei Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Addalachchenei Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local government positions, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members.
